Screw Blocks can be useful for rescuing high-up Grumbles, or scaffolding loosely stacked blocks to prevent unwanted Topples!  

🧱 Just be careful not to screw them where they'll block your progress! 🧱

[*] punish button-mashy rapid drops directly from the top of your playfield
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] characters will generally move faster especially delving downwards on their bungee
[*] if your character drops too many blocks too quickly, they'll get tired and need to catch their breath
